title: CallEvent
description: One event in a call's control/transcript log, emitted by control_api and consumed by the telephony MCP server and other integrations. Ordering is per-call via `seq`.

seq.description: Monotonic per-call sequence number starting at 1.

at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the event occurred.

data.description: Event payload. For utterance.* events this carries `{ "text": string }`. No secrets.
